label: When Inspector Gregory examined the stables and out-houses round Tavistock
quote: I have also examined every stable and out-house in Tavistock, and for a radius of ten miles
note: Before Holmes and Watson arrive; not otherwise dated.

label: When Inspector Gregory examined the Mapleton stables
quote: We have, however, examined the stables, and there is nothing to connect him with the affair
note: Before Holmes and Watson arrive; not ordered against the other searches.

label: Tuesday, when the gypsies were gone
note: The gypsies were encamped on Monday night within a mile of the spot of the murder (¶62).

label: When the traces of the gypsies' camp were found
quote: We have found traces which show that a party of gypsies encamped on Monday night

label: Two summers when Fitzroy Simpson lodged at Tavistock
quote: He has twice lodged at Tavistock in the summer
note: Before the story; two stays, not otherwise dated.

label: When Silas Brown laid his bets upon the Wessex Cup
quote: Silas Brown, the trainer, is known to have had large bets upon the event
note: Before the race; not otherwise dated.

label: When Fitzroy Simpson says he lost his cravat
quote: declares that he had lost it
note: Simpson's claim only; the maid says the stranger wore it on Monday evening (¶35).

label: Thursday evening, at Tavistock station
quote: It was evening before we reached the little town of Tavistock
note: Colonel Ross and Inspector Gregory meet them in the station (¶47–50).

label: Thursday evening, driving in the landau through Tavistock
quote: A minute later we were all seated in a comfortable landau, and were rattling through the quaint old Devonshire city
note: Gregory's talk of the case with Holmes (¶51–68); the moor is being scoured for the gypsies at this time (¶64).
